identity.heading: Identity verification
identity.whyOwner: Upload a photo of yourself and one government document. Players book grounds from strangers, so a verified owner is what the platform asks for before a turf goes live.
identity.body: Any one of an NID, driving licence, birth certificate or passport is enough.
identity.photoHint: A clear photo of your face, in daylight. It is shown on your profile.
identity.numberHint: Kept private. Only a reviewer sees it in full.
identity.frontHint: The side with your photo and number.
identity.backHint: An NID and a driving licence carry the address on the back.
identity.replace: On file. Choosing a new one replaces it.
identity.saveFailed: That did not save. Check your connection and try again.
identity.submittedNote: With a reviewer now. We will tell you as soon as it is decided — usually within a day.

missing.photo: Add a photo of yourself first.

username.body: Your @handle. Players use it to invite you to matches and squads, and it opens your player profile.
